page.layout: One printed page with one column of running text. Running head at the top, with the page number at the top left. Mark "§" in the right margin beside the last line. No notes in the margins.

main_text.l: clara anni 1074. describit. Mira tum erat in
Episcopis ejus temporis constantia. Confi-
denter enim & negligebant & damnabant
sanctiones & decreta Romani praesulis, uxo-
resque secundum verbum Domini retine-
bant. Gangrensis anno Domini 333[?]. & sexta
tum vertialis synodus, ut citatur Dilti.31. can.
acriter defendit[?] conjugium facerdotum: sic-u-
& Nicaena pro eo contra necessitatem cę-
libatus conclusit anno salutis 313. His & Pa-
normitanus insignis jurisconsultus assen-
[?]tit. c. cum olim, de Cleri. conjug. Chrysosto-
mus in Epistolam ad Titum verba Aposto-
li, Si quis est sine crimine unius uxoris vir,
sic exponit: Obstruere prorsus intendit hae-
reticorum ora, qui nuptias damnant: olten-
des eam rem culpa carere, imo ita esse precio
sam, ut cum ipsa etiā possit quispiam ad
sanctum Episcopatus folium subvehi, Pius se-
cundus, priusquam Pontifex factus calicem
Icortationis[?] Babylonicæ Regibus porri-
gendum in manus fumpsisset, palam dixit:
Sacerdotibus magna ratione sublatas nu-
ptias, majori restituendas videri. Quare er-
go cum pontificatum esset adeptus, non re-
stituit Ecclesiis, quod tam gravibus de cau-
sis restituendum esse sciebat? Scilicet, non
est hoc Romanorum pontificum, ut quod
justum & æquum est, imò necessarium ec-
clesiis[?], statuant: sed ut neab aliis tale quid
tentetur, totis viribus, igne, gladio, &c. im-
pediant.
Sed

page.notes: The "§" in the right margin beside "Sed" is a paragraph mark, not text. Small stray marks appear at the left margin near "sanctum" and as printer's ornaments near "subvehi" and "factus"; these are not printed words. The date "333" and the reference "Dilti.31" are hard to read in the scan. "Icortationis" and "ecclesiis" are doubtful readings. "decretaRomani" is printed with no space between the words. "olten-des" appears as printed. The running head is spaced as "C O N C I O N E S" in the scan; it is given here as CONCIONES.
